d: Hero's stand at EICMA was jampacked with new ICE and electric two- and three-wheelers with the most stnadout showcase among them being of the long-awaited Xpulse 450. Joining it were the downsized Harley-Davidson X350 T and Vida Ubex electric bike as well as the Nex 2 electric three-wheeled scooter. Join Rishaad Mody as he tells you everything that's interesting about these offerings.
